data.summary: Product owner with extensive experience at Infogain, specializing in payment solutions and SaaS applications. Proven ability to manage product backlogs and implement agile methodologies, resulting in enhanced team productivity and high-quality product delivery. Successfully led solution implementations, aligning payment methods with client objectives and fostering a culture of continuous improvement through effective backlog prioritization.

responsibilities: Analyzed and prioritized global/regional change requests, ensuring alignment with business objectives and enterprise architecture.
Elicited, validated, and documented business requirements, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria.
Led impact assessments across payment systems, identifying dependencies, risks, and downstream impacts.
Defined MVP scope and managed product backlog to deliver high-value, cost-effective solutions.
Collaborated with business, operations, compliance, architects, and technology teams to design and deliver regulatory and business-driven changes.
Facilitated requirement workshops, stakeholder reviews, and solution walkthroughs across global teams.
Supported SIT, UAT, and production validation by reviewing test scenarios, resolving requirement-related queries, and securing stakeholder sign-offs.
Ensured operational readiness by assessing impacts on investigations, reconciliation, billing, monitoring, controls, and reporting processes.
Drove operational efficiency improvements through enhanced Straight-Through Processing (STP) and process optimization.
Managed post-implementation support, issue resolution, and hypercare activities to ensure successful production rollout.
Acted as a liaison between business and technology teams, ensuring seamless delivery across the change lifecycle.
Promoted continuous improvement in requirement management, testing, defect resolution, and delivery processes.

NICE Performance Management (NPM) is an enterprise workforce engagement solution that empowers contact center teams by combining real-time insights, agentic AI, and gamification. It personalizes employee coaching and drives continuous performance improvement at scale. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
Managed and prioritized the product backlog to ensure delivery of high-value features aligned with business objectives and customer needs.
Continuously monitored product performance, identified improvement opportunities, and drove enhancements to optimize user experience and business outcomes.
Gathered and analyzed customer feedback, market insights, and stakeholder inputs to define product enhancements and prioritize future initiatives.
Guided and mentored team members on Agile principles, Product Owner responsibilities, and best practices to improve team effectiveness and delivery quality.
Collaborated closely with development teams to design and deliver customized solutions, applications, and tracking mechanisms that met client requirements and business goals.
Acted as a bridge between business stakeholders and engineering teams, ensuring clear communication of requirements, priorities, and acceptance criteria.
Facilitated Agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and stakeholder demonstrations, to support successful product delivery.
Facilitated Scrum framework - sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily scrums, sprint reviews, and sprint retrospectives.
Conducted daily stand-up meetings, sprint planning sessions, and sprint reviews, ensuring effective communication among team members.
Worked closely and listened to team members' feedback to identify issues and resolve conflicts.
Developed custom Scrum boards for better task tracking and transparency within the team.
Collaborated with Product Owners to refine requirements and ensure alignment with business goals.
Domain: EMM (Enterprise Marketing Management)
